items.summaryZh: 红牛车队领队劳伦特·梅基斯表示，伊萨克·哈贾尔的手腕伤势需要更多时间恢复，可能无法在西班牙大奖赛重返F1。哈贾尔在夏季休赛期训练中受伤，缺席了赞德福特和蒙站的比赛周末。

items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies says Isack Hadjar needs more time to recover from his wrist injury and is unlikely to return to Formula 1 at the Spanish Grand Prix. Hadjar was injured in training during the summer break and missed the Zandvoort and Monza race weekends.
detailZh: 红红牛就伊萨克·哈贾尔的康复时间表发布最新消息
洛朗·梅基斯提供了关于伊萨克·哈贾尔手腕伤势恢复的最新信息
红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯表示，伊萨克·哈贾尔的手腕伤势需要更多时间恢复，他不太可能在西班牙大奖赛重返一级方程式（Formula 1）。
哈贾尔在夏休期训练中伤了手腕，这一挫折使他错过了赞德沃特和蒙扎的一级方程式（Formula 1）比赛周末。他已被利亚姆·劳森替代加盟红牛，角田裕毅因此转而替阵小红牛（小红牛）。
哈贾尔曾向马克·马尔克斯寻求建议，因为这位七届MotoGP冠军在过去六年中曾饱受多次长期伤病困扰，有时还因马尔克斯过早复出而加重伤情。
因此，这位21岁车手的理念是不急于求成，而红牛车队对此完全支持。
“听着，伊萨克没问题，”梅基斯在第一次自由练习赛期间对法国广播机构Canal+表示。“他现在不能开车，所以显然，我不会告诉你他很开心——因为他并不开心。
“但最首要的任务是他的康复。我们没有任何理由在这方面冒险。他本赛季至今的表现非常出色，他还很年轻，每次驾驶赛车都有进步，所以他百分之百康复后再复出是很重要的。”
“所以我们会拿出一切所需的时间，尊重他的感受和医生的指导，给他需要的休养时间。我相信我们很快就会笑着谈起这件事。”,
至于哈贾尔能否在下周马德里首届马德里林（马德里赛道）赛道比赛中重返赛场，梅基斯悲观地思考道：“马德里的比赛几天后就到了，所以这很棘手。我们会重新评估他的状况，但把目标定在马德里可能确实很难。
“但我们会一场比赛一场比赛来，用更理性的方式共同评估。再说一遍，首要的、会影响我们决定的因素，是确保他以百分之百的状态回归，并且对他的未来没有任何风险。”
尽管目前暂别赛场，但由于国际上诉法院对摩纳哥大奖赛的裁决，哈贾尔今天的2026赛季积分还增加了。加斯利的超速处罚被恢复执行，这意味着哈贾尔重新获得了他最初的领奖台名次。
detailEn: Red Bull gives update on Isack Hadjar’s recovery timeline
Laurent Mekies has provided the latest information regarding Isack Hadjar’s recovery from his wrist injury
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies says Isack Hadjar needs more time to recover from his wrist injury and is unlikely to return to Formula 1 at the Spanish Grand Prix.

Hadjar injured his wrist in training during the summer break, with the setback ruling him out of the Zandvoort and Monza F1 weekends. He has been replaced by Liam Lawson at Red Bull, with Yuki Tsunoda consequently standing in at Racing Bulls.

Hadjar has sought advice from Marc Marquez, as the seven-time MotoGP champion has infamously suffered from several long-lasting injuries in the past six years, sometimes aggravated by Marquez returning to action prematurely.
So the 21-year-old’s ethos has been not to rush things, which Red Bull has been fully onboard with.
“Look, Isack is okay,” Mekies told French broadcaster Canal+ during FP1. “He can’t drive now so, obviously, I’m not going to tell you he’s happy – because he’s not.

“But the absolute priority is his recovery. We have no reason to take risks with it. His season so far has been fantastic, he’s very young, he improves every time he drives the car, so it’s important for him to return when he’s 100%.
“So we’ll take whatever time is required, trust his feeling and the doctors’ guidance, and give him the time he needs. We’ll soon laugh about this, I’m sure.”

As to whether Hadjar will make it back on track at Madrid’s inaugural Madring race next weekend, Mekies pessimistically pondered: “Madrid is a few days from now, so that’s tricky. We’ll reevaluate his situation, but targeting Madrid probably is tricky.

“But we’re taking things one race at a time and we’re looking at it together in a more rational way. Again, the priority, what will influence our decision, is being sure he returns at 100% and with zero risks for his future.”

Albeit currently sidelined, Hadjar saw his 2026 points tally increase today, courtesy of the International Court of Appeal’s ruling on the Monaco Grand Prix. Pierre Gasly’s speeding penalties have been reinstated, meaning Hadjar has recovered his initial podium finish.

items.summaryEn: Formula 1 has announced that F1 Live Milan, a three-day season launch event, will take place in Milan, Italy, from 18-20 February 2027, featuring all 11 teams, 22 drivers and live entertainment.
detailZh: F1宣布计划于2027年在米兰举办盛大的赛季启动仪式
一级方程式将于2027年2月在米兰举行为期三天的赛季启动仪式，届时将汇集全部11支车队、22位车手以及现场娱乐表演
一级方程式已宣布计划在意大利举办一场为期三天的赛季启动仪式，F1 米兰现场活动定于2027年2月18日至20日举行。
赛程的焦点将是“F1 The Show”（F1大秀），该活动定于2月18日晚间举行，形式类似于2025年在伦敦举办的F1 75活动。伦敦那场活动吸引了750万现场观众收看。
F1 The Show 将汇聚整个车界的11支车队和22位车手，以及娱乐和音乐表演节目。
为期三天日程中其余的活动和赛事尚未确认，但将成为米兰车迷节的一部分。
“我们总是志存高远、不断突破界限，F1 Live Milan 将是一场以车迷为核心打造的精彩绝伦的体验。我们希望他们感觉到自己不仅仅是在观看这项运动，而是真正沉浸其中，”F1 首席执行官 Stefano Domenicali 说。
“这是我们持续雄心的重要一环，即让 Formula 1 比以往任何时候都更贴近车迷，让他们有机会近距离目睹自己心目中的英雄，并亲身体验那种让 Formula 1 如此独特的活力、创新与激情。”
“随着F1不断在世界范围内吸引新的观众，赛车永远是我们的灵魂——但我们也希望创造难忘的体验，以更大的规模将一级方程式的激情变为现实，并继续探索一切可能性。
“在伦敦F1 75取得巨大成功的基础上，F1 Live Milan将把米兰变成一个为期三天、令人难忘的一级方程式嘉年华，把来自世界各地的人们聚集在一起，共同庆祝他们热爱这项运动的一切。
“我知道我的意大利同胞们将为前来参加F1 Live Milan的车迷们送上精彩的欢迎，我迫不及待地想看到这座城市因一级方程式的活力而焕发生机，创造一生难忘的回忆。
有关这项活动的更多详情预计将在未来几个月内公布，门票将于今年晚些时候开售。
detailEn: F1 announces plans for huge 2027 season launch in Milan
Formula 1 will stage a three-day season launch event in Milan in February 2027, featuring all 11 teams, 22 drivers and live entertainment
Formula 1 has announced plans for a three-day season launch event in Italy, with F1 Live Milan scheduled to take place from 18-20 February 2027.

The focal point of the schedule will be F1 The Show, which is set for the evening of 18 February and will be similar to the F1 75 event, held in London in 2025. The London edition drew in an audience of 7.5 million live viewers.
F1 The Show will bring together the whole grid of 11 teams and 22 drivers as well as entertainment and music acts.
Activities and events for the remainder of the three-day schedule are yet to be confirmed but will be part of the Milan Fan Festival.

"We are always thinking big and pushing boundaries, and F1 Live Milan is going to be an incredible experience created with our fans at its heart. We want them to feel that they are not simply watching the sport, but they are truly immersed in it," F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali said.

"It is an important part of our ongoing ambition to bring Formula 1 closer to fans than ever before, giving them the chance to see their heroes up close and experience the energy, innovation, and emotion that make Formula 1 so unique.

"As F1 continues to reach new audiences around the world, racing will always be our soul – but we also want to create unforgettable experiences that bring the excitement of Formula 1 to life on an even bigger scale and continue to explore what is possible.

"Building on the extraordinary success of F1 75 in London, F1 Live Milan will transform the city into a Formula 1 festival for three unforgettable days, bringing people together from across the globe to celebrate everything they love about our sport.

"I know my fellow Italians will offer a fantastic welcome to fans travelling to F1 Live Milan and I cannot wait to see the city come to life with Formula 1 energy, creating memories that will last a lifetime."
More details about the event are expected in the coming months and tickets will go on sale later this year.

items.originalTitle: F1将于2027年在米兰举办赛季启动活动
items.summaryEn: Formula 1 will hold a 2027 season launch event called 'F1 The Show' in Milan on February 18, marking a return to the format two years after F1 75 Live at the O2 arena.
detailZh: 一级方程式将于明年二月在米兰举行2027赛季发布活动，这距离在O2体育馆举办的F1 75 Live活动已有两年。
由喜剧演员Jack Whitehall主持的F1 75 Live活动对F1来说是第一次，它将全部10支车队和20位车手齐聚一堂，并仅在一晚之内展示所有2025年的涂装。
F1一直希望重办这一活动，但在繁忙的2026年季前准备期间，由于新规出台以及三次独立的季前测试，该活动未能举行，而发布活动将以扩展的形式于2027年重返米兰。
这场为期一晚的发布活动“F1 The Show”将于2月18日在一个尚未确认的“标志性城市场地”举行，届时全部11支车队的车手和车队负责人都将到场，还将有“音乐、娱乐节目以及更多内容”。
2月18日至20日，市内还将举办为期三天的车迷节。
这两项活动的更多细节将于日后公布。
门票将于今年晚些时候开售，车迷现在可以预先登记对这项活动的兴趣。与F1 75 Live一样，该活动将在全球范围内播出。
本周早些时候，在意大利大奖赛之前的周三，米兰举办了多场法拉利活动，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔的亮相吸引了大量人群聚集在城市街道上。
detailEn: Formula 1 will hold a 2027 season launch event in Milan next February, two years on from its F1 75 Live event at the O2 arena.
The F1 75 Live event hosted by comedian Jack Whitehall was a first for F1, bringing together all 10 teams and 20 drivers and showcasing every 2025 livery for one night only.

F1 has been keen to repeat it, and while it wasn’t held amid a busy 2026 pre-season with new regulations and three separate pre-season tests, the launch event will return in 2027 in Milan in an expanded form.

The one-night launch event ‘F1 The Show’ will be held at a yet-to-be-confirmed “iconic city venue” on February 18, with drivers and team principals from all 11 teams and “music, entertainment, and more”.
There’s also a three-day fan festival in the city taking place across February 18-20.
More details of both events will be released at a later date.
Tickets will go on sale later this year and fans can pre-register their interest in the event now. As with F1 75 Live, the event will be broadcast around the world.

Milan hosted multiple Ferrari events on the Wednesday prior to the Italian GP, with Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc’s appearances attracting huge crowds on the streets of the city earlier this week.

items.summaryEn: The FIA's International Court of Appeal ruled that Pierre Gasly's Monaco Grand Prix speeding penalties did stand, a decision that significantly affects the standings and costs Alpine dearly.
detailZh: 摩纳哥大奖赛裁决后的F1锦标赛积分榜：阿尔派蒙受损失
上诉法院决定恢复加斯利在摩纳哥大奖赛的处罚，这使车队在争夺锦标赛第五名的战斗中付出了沉重代价
在国际汽联国际上诉法院于周五裁定加斯利在摩纳哥大奖赛的超速处罚成立之后，这一裁决对积分榜的影响值得注意。
Gasly是该项赛事中多名被抓到超速的车手之一，但人们发现维修区通道的测速数据并不准确，这为阿尔派成功申请复议铺平了道路——与其他车队不同，那些车队旗下的车手已经服完了各自的处罚。
然而国际汽联（ICA）恢复了这些处罚，这意味着加斯利在摩纳哥比赛的排名中退回至第七位，而不是第三位。
这一处罚对积分榜产生了重大影响，尤其是对车队冠军榜。阿尔派 损失了九分，而竞争对手 小红牛 则获得了四分，劳森 和 Arvid Lindblad 在摩纳哥比赛结果中各上升一个名次。在争夺第五名的较量中，这是13分的摆动，而此前两支车队之间仅相差三分。
迈凯伦 和 红牛 也各获得了一些积分，尽管这不太可能在顶级车队之间产生巨大影响。
与此同时，在车手积分榜上，第七名到第十一名的所有车手都受到了影响，加斯利目前落后排名第九的 Lawson 16分，而此前只落后5分，同时他对 Lindblad 的21分优势也被削减至10分。
detailEn: F1 championship standings after Monaco GP ruling: Alpine loses out
The Court of Appeal's decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly's Monaco GP penalties is costing the team dear in the battle for fifth in the championship
After the FIA's International Court of Appeal ruled on Friday that Pierre Gasly's Monaco Grand Prix speeding penalties did stand, the impact on the standings is noteworthy.

Gasly was one of several drivers who were caught speeding during the race in the principality, but it was found that the pitlane measurements were inaccurate, which paved the way for Alpine to successfully request a right of review – unlike other teams whose drivers had served their own penalties.
The ICA's has however reinstated these penalties, meaning Gasly has dropped back to seventh in the Monaco race classification, instead of third.

There are substantial ramifications in the standings, especially in the constructors' championship. Alpine has lost nine points while rival Racing Bulls has gained four, with Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad bumped up one spot each in the Monaco results. That's a 13-point swing in the battle for fifth position, when those teams were separated by just three points before the decision.
McLaren and Red Bull also gained a few points each, although this is unlikely to make a huge difference among top teams.

Meanwhile, in the drivers' standings, all racers from seventh to 11th have been impacted, with Gasly finding himself 16 points down on ninth-placed Lawson instead of five previously, while his 21-point advantage over Lindblad has been slashed to 10.

items.titleZh: 兰多·诺里斯新赛车团队收到“数百份求职申请”
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯周三宣布组建单座车队LN4 Fusion和车手发展计划LN4 Legacy，希望帮助缺乏资金支持的天才车手一路走向F1。他的新团队已收到数百份求职申请。

media.altZh: 兰多·诺里斯新赛车团队收到“数百份求职申请”

items.originalTitle: 兰多·诺里斯新赛车团队收到“数百份求职申请”
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris announced on Wednesday the launch of the single-seater team LN4 Fusion and the LN4 Legacy driver programme, hoping to help underfunded talent work their way to Formula 1. His new race team has already received a few hundred job requests.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯的新车队收到了"几百份工作申请"
兰多·诺里斯解释了建立自己单人座赛车队以及青训车手计划的原因
兰多·诺里斯表示，他希望建立自己的青训车队和车手计划，能够帮助那些缺乏资金支持的天才车手一路走向一级方程式。
周三，诺里斯宣布了两个独立的项目；一支名为 LN4 Fusion 的单人座赛车队，以及旨在通过国际汽联（FIA）的晋级体系支持年轻车手职业生涯的 LN4 Legacy 计划。
LN4 Fusion将由前Prema车队长期领队Rene Rosin执掌，Dan Hazlewood负责车队的英国分部，目前正致力于在F2、F3和英国F4中派车参赛。
LN4 Legacy Programme由前阿尔派体育总监Julian Rouse领导，是一个全额资助的项目，旨在一路支持年轻天才直至最高级别。Norris表示，面对单座赛车赛事不断飙升的成本，他热衷于回馈这项运动。
“Legacy Programme更多的是挑选出我们相信能够进入F1的个人，并尝试一次帮助一个人。这是我们最初的目标，”Norris解释道，“车手们必须付出额外的努力才能做到这一点，我认为这恰恰承认了这件事有多难。”
考虑到所涉及的资金，LN4 Legacy Programme初期将赞助一名尚未公布姓名的年轻车手，但Norris希望未来能够筹集更多资金来扩大该计划的规模。
“我们所说的规模，是指启动这样的项目需要数千万起步。而且你需要来自众多投资者的有力支持之类的东西。这很容易成为，而且将会是一个长期项目，”他说。
“我们总得从某处开始。我很高兴我正在努力先帮助一个起步，然后我们会做第二个，然后第三个、第四个和第五个。”
在车队方面，诺里斯表示，前Prema掌门人罗辛是与这支意大利豪门车队竞争多年后，担任LN4 Fusion掌门的理想人选，而罗辛在去年冬天交出家族车队控制权后，出人意料地变得可以加盟。
“我认识雷内很多年了，从我开始进入方程式赛车的时候就认识了，”诺里斯解释道。“我们想组建一个有经验、懂得如何领导车队的团队，而不仅仅是打造一支好车队——不管那只是在F3还是只在F2——而是能够组建一个项目和一些长期的东西。
"在过去七年里，我也得以体验到什么才能造就一个好的领导者、一支好的团队。很多东西都始于最顶层的那个人，而他就是那个人。他是必然的选择。"
诺里斯透露，罗辛收到了来自各方的浓厚兴趣，希望加入LN4 Fusion车队，该项目从行业内各处都获得了积极的反响。
多里安·平（Doriane Pin），PREMA车队；PREMA车队的雷内·罗辛（Rene Rosin）
"各方面的反应都非常棒。雷内说，在消息公布后的大约一个小时内，他就收到了好几百份求职申请，" 诺里斯说。"所以，无论是车手，还是机械师、工程师，以及所有构成车队的人员，都有着广泛的吸引力。我很自豪我们能够打造出一些非常特别的东西。"
诺里斯感谢他身边组建的团队帮助他承担像这样的项目，这意味着他仍然可以专注于自己在迈凯伦的本职工作，并在有空的时候参与其中。
但他也清醒地认识到，仅靠他的项目，或者同为世界冠军的维斯塔潘的GT3赛车队，还不足以产生持久的影响，因此他呼吁国际汽联（FIA）和F1管理层帮助降低初级方程式赛车的过高成本。
"如果你想帮助那些起步条件更差、更难以开始赛车运动、让人们得以追求梦想的更大范围的经济体，这远不止是我做好本职工作并尽力帮忙那么简单，"他说，"这需要这项运动本身的努力。这需要F1、国际汽联以及卡丁车公司做更多的工作。"
"费用实在太高了，所以你不能指望人们仅仅去资助更多人。你必须找到其他方法，让人们更容易开始赛车，尤其是在经济方面。你必须设法降低车队的成本、参加测试的费用，甚至报名参加F2的费用。F2的起步费用超过200万欧元，我想。
"你总得从某个地方起步。我的能力就是先从一个开始，而这本身已经是一个很大的项目了。希望随着时间推移，有更多的合作伙伴加入，带来更多的资金和支持，我们能把它变成一种帮助来自世界各地更多人的方式。"
detailEn: Lando Norris' new race team received "a few hundred job requests"
Lando Norris explains the reasoning behind establishing his own single-seater team and junior driver programme
Lando Norris says he hopes establishing his own junior team and driver programme can help guide underfunded talent all the way to the Formula 1.
On Wednesday Norris announced two separate projects; a single-seater race team called LN4 Fusion and the LN4 Legacy programme which aims to support a young driver's career through the FIA's ladder.
LN4 Fusion will be run by former long-time Prema team boss Rene Rosin, with Dan Hazlewood running the team's UK arm, and is working on fielding cars in F2, F3 and British F4.

LN4 Legacy Programme, led by former Alpine sporting director Julian Rouse, is a fully-funded programme aimed at supporting young talents all the way to the top. Norris says he was keen to give back to the sport in the face of the spiralling costs of single-seater racing.

"The legacy programme is more to pick out individuals, people that we believe can get to Formula 1 and try and help them one at a time. That's our initial goal," Norris explained. "The fact that drivers have to kind of go out of their way to do it is, I think, an acknowledgement of how difficult it is."
Given the finances involved, LN4 Legacy Programme is starting by backing one yet-to-be-named junior driver, but Norris is hoping he can raise the backing to scale up the programme in the future.

"The scale we're talking about, you're talking tens of millions to start projects like this. And you need good backing from a lot of investors, things like that. And that can easily be and will be a longer-term project," he said.
"We've got to start somewhere. And I'm happy that I'm trying to help at least one to begin with, and then we'll work on two and then three and then four and five."

On the team side, Norris said former Prema chief Rosin was the ideal candidate to lead LN4 Fusion after racing against the Italian's powerhouse team for years, and Rosin surprisingly became available after ceding control of the family-owned team last winter.

"I've known Rene for many years, since I started to go into single-seaters," Norris explained. "We wanted to put together a group that is experienced and knows how to lead a team and not just create one good team, whether that's just in F3 or just in F2, but be able to put together a project and something long term.

"I've also been able to experience over the course of the last seven years what makes a good leader, what makes a good team. A lot of it starts with the person at the very top and he is that person. He was the inevitable choice."
Norris revealed Rosin had received plenty of interest from various corners to join LN4 Fusion, with the project getting a positive reception from around the industry.
Doriane Pin, PREMA Racing, Rene Rosin of PREMA

"The reactions have been great. Rene said he got over a few hundred job requests within the space of an hour or so of the announcement," Norris said. "So, there's a lot of attraction from a range of drivers, but also mechanics, engineers, all the people that make a team. I'm proud that we've been able to put something very special together."
Norris credited the team he had built around him for helping him take on projects like this, meaning he can still focus on his day job at McLaren and pitch in whenever he is available.

But he was also conscious that it will take much more than his project, or fellow world champion Max Verstappen's GT3 race team, to make a lasting impact, as he called upon the FIA and on F1 management to help bring the exorbitant costs on the single-seater ladder.

"If you want to help bigger areas and economies that are just worse to kind of start racing and allow people to start their dream, it's much bigger than just me doing my job and trying to help out on that," he said. "That takes the sport itself. That takes a lot more work from F1, from FIA, from karting companies.

"It's just simply too expensive, so you cannot rely on people just to fund more people. You have to find other ways to make it more friendly for people to start racing and especially financially. You've got to lower the costs somehow of teams, of the ability to go testing, of just signing up to do Formula 2. F2 is over €2million euros, I think, to start.

"You've got to start somewhere. My ability is starting with one and that's already a big project. Hopefully, over time and with more partners coming on board and more money, more support, we can turn it into a way of helping more people from around the world."
keyPointsZh: LN4 Fusion将由前Prema长期成员运营
LN4 Legacy计划旨在通过FIA的阶梯赛事支持年轻车手的职业生涯
keyPointsEn: LN4 Fusion will be run by a long-time former Prema member.

items.titleZh: 蒙托亚警告：迈凯伦势不可挡，诺里斯冲击2026冠军
items.summaryZh: 前F1车手胡安·帕布罗·蒙托亚认为，迈凯伦随着队内信心增长，在2026赛季冠军争夺中已变得“难以阻挡”。卫冕冠军兰多·诺里斯在匈牙利和荷兰大奖赛连续夺冠后，本周末将出战意大利大奖赛。

items.originalTitle: 前F1车手警告：迈凯伦势不可挡，诺里斯冲击2026冠军
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya believes McLaren has become "hard to stop" in the 2026 championship as confidence grows within the team. Reigning champion Lando Norris heads into this weekend's Italian Grand Prix on the back of consecutive victories at the Hungarian and Dutch Grands Prix.
detailZh: 前F1车手警告称，随着兰多·诺里斯争夺2026年冠军，迈凯伦正变得"难以阻挡"
胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚认为，随着车队内部信心不断增强，迈凯伦和兰多·诺里斯正变得越来越难以阻挡
前一级方程式车手胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚认为，随着迈凯伦在2026年锦标赛中信心不断增强，这支车队已经变得"难以阻挡"。
卫冕冠军兰多·诺里斯在匈牙利大奖赛和荷兰大奖赛上连续两场夺冠后，将参加本周末的意大利大奖赛。尽管诺里斯仍然落后梅赛德斯车队的积分领跑者基米·安东内利83分，但迈凯伦正在迅速缩小差距。
在F1 TV的《周末热身》节目中，蒙托亚称赞了这支沃金车队敢于冒更大的风险。
"我们看到的是一支正在成长的迈凯伦，一支开始把一切都整合起来的迈凯伦，一支在策略上不惧怕冒险的迈凯伦，"蒙托亚解释道。
"去年他们拥有最快的赛车，处于赢得比赛的境地，但他们害怕犯错、害怕输掉比赛，而现在他们是弱势一方，他们全力以赴，而且这正在奏效。"
这位50岁的人士补充说，随着诺里斯和他所在车队的信心不断增强，他的势头可能"难以阻止"。
“而当你开始这样做并且奏效时，车队和你周围的人的信心就会不断增强，到那时就很难阻止他了，”他说。
蒙托亚还将诺里斯对MCL40的信任与队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里进行了对比，后者近来一直难以从赛车上发挥出同样的性能。
“他在排位赛中的表现确实很好，”蒙托亚谈到皮亚斯特里时说。“他总是在那里。单圈时他开得非常从容，当他用上适合他的轮胎配方时他非常快，但不知为何，现在当他用较热的轮胎时，这辆车似乎就变得很难驾驭。”
“我认为他们还没有为他找到最佳调校点。他并没有损失任何速度。人们很容易说‘哦，兰多干得真出色。’
“Lando只是对这辆赛车很适应，当你信任这辆车时，你就可以晚点刹车，可以让车滑行入弯，甚至可以在即将转向入弯时把车‘扔’进去。”
“如果你不知道这辆车会做什么，你也永远不会松开刹车。你永远无法保持那种速度。这就是很大的区别。”
detailEn: Former F1 driver warns McLaren is becoming "hard to stop" as Lando Norris fights for 2026 title
Juan Pablo Montoya believes McLaren and Lando Norris are becoming increasingly difficult to stop as confidence grows within the team
Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya believes McLaren has become "hard to stop" as it gains confidence in the 2026 championship.

Reigning champion Lando Norris heads into this weekend's Italian Grand Prix on the back of two consecutive victories at the Hungarian and Dutch Grands Prix. Though Norris still trails Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 83 points, McLaren is rapidly closing the gap.
Speaking on F1 TV's Weekend Warm-Up show, Montoya praised the Woking outfit for taking more risks.
"The combination we're seeing is a McLaren that is growing, a McLaren that is starting to put everything together, a McLaren that is not afraid of taking risks with strategy," Montoya explained.

"Last year they were put in a position with the fastest car where they were winning races, but they were afraid of making mistakes and losing races, whereas now they're the underdog and they're going for broke, and it's working."
The 50-year-old added that Norris's momentum could be "hard to stop" as the confidence grows within him and the team.
"And when you start doing things like that, and it works, the confidence in the team and the people around you just grows, and it's going to be hard to stop him," he said.
Montoya also pointed to Norris's trust in the MCL40 compared to team-mate Oscar Piastri, who has recently struggled to extract the same performance from the car.

"He's doing a really good job in qualifying," Montoya said of Piastri. "He's always there. On one lap he's driving really comfortably and when he's in the right compound for him he's very quick, but for some reason when he now seems to be on a hotter tyre, the car seems to be tricky to drive.
"I don't think they've found the sweet spot for him. He hasn't lost any speed. It's very easy to say, 'Oh Lando's doing such a good job.'
"Lando's just comfortable with the car, and when you trust the car, you can come off the brakes, you can roll the car in, you can throw the car in when you're going to turn in.
"If you don't know what the car is going to do, you're never going to release the brakes as well. You're never going to carry that speed. And that's a big difference."

keyPointsEn: Norris still trails Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 83 points, but McLaren is rapidly closing the gap

items.titleZh: 意大利大奖赛一练：勒克莱尔领跑法拉利包揽一二
items.summaryZh: 在蒙扎举行的意大利大奖赛第一次自由练习赛中，勒克莱尔以1分23.008秒位列榜首，法拉利包揽前二，主场作战取得令人鼓舞的开局。
items.originalTitle: 意大利大奖赛一练：主场车队表现令人鼓舞
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc topped first practice for the Italian Grand Prix at Monza with a 1m23.008s, leading a Ferrari one-two in an encouraging start at the team's home race.
detailZh: 夏尔·勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔）领跑法拉利包揽意大利大奖赛一练前两名，这标志着法拉利ADUO 2升级版F1引擎在车队主场赛事中迎来了一个令人鼓舞的开端。
法拉利决定在蒙扎的一练中完全不使用软胎，两台赛车在练习赛的前半段都使用硬胎，随后切换到中性胎。
勒克莱尔以1分23.008秒的最佳成绩登上榜首，刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）随后以0.173秒之差排名第二。
乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）驾驶两台梅赛德斯中更快的一台取得第三快，他使用软胎做出的单圈比勒克莱尔的法拉利慢0.304秒。
锦标赛领跑者安东内利在本站主场赛事为他的梅赛德斯更换了新发动机，将从前排最末位发车，他本节排名第五，落后最快成绩0.6秒，仅比红牛车手劳森慢不到0.2秒——Lawson本周末再次代替受伤的哈贾尔出战。
在过去两站大奖赛中为迈凯伦夺冠的诺里斯排名第六，与法拉利两车一样使用中性胎，身后是小红牛、驾驶奥迪的博托莱托，以及阿尔派车手科拉平托和新秀Paul Aron。
Aron是本节出现的四位新秀车手中最快的一位，尽管与其他赛车有过几次险些相撞的情况——其中包括小红牛替补车手角田裕毅，他在接近Parabolica弯时被阿尔派赛车挡住。
皮亚斯特里在另一辆迈凯伦中仅排名第11位，尽管使用了软胎。迈凯伦还在本节测试了其新的倒置H形尾翼。
角田裕毅排名最快第11位，排在尼科·霍肯伯格的奥迪和奥利·比尔曼之前，比尔曼的哈斯车队是本周末唯一使用新法拉利发动机的客户车队。
新秀FP1（第一次练习赛）车手卢克·布朗宁仅比常规威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯快不到十分之一秒，尽管他在第一个减速弯有几次失误，不过与布朗宁不同，塞恩斯在FP1中没有使用软胎。
岩佐步梦驾驶马克斯·维斯塔潘的红牛仅排名第17位，比动力不足的阿斯顿·马丁上的费尔南多·阿隆索快了半秒（另一名不使用软胎的车手）。
科尔顿·赫塔是另一位FP1替补车手，但在他能够做出有效单圈时间之前，通常由塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯驾驶的凯迪拉克因疑似液压系统故障而抛锚。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc led a Ferrari one-two in first practice for the Italian Grand Prix, marking an encouraging start for Ferrari’s ADUO 2 upgraded F1 engine at the team’s home race.
Ferrari decided not to use the soft tyre at all in FP1 at Monza, running the hard compound on both cars for the early part of the session before switching to the medium.
Leclerc went to the top on a 1m23.008s best, with Lewis Hamilton later slotting into second, 0.173s down.
George Russell was third fastest in the quickest of the Mercedes, using the soft tyre to lap 0.304s slower than Leclerc’s Ferrari.

Championship leader Kimi Antonelli, who will start from the back of the grid after taking a new Mercedes engine for his home race, was fifth, six tenths off the pace and just under two tenths behind the Red Bull of Liam Lawson, who is again subbing for the injured Isack Hadjar this weekend.

Lando Norris, winner of the past two grands prix for McLaren, rounded out the top six, like the Ferraris using the medium tyre, ahead of Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls), Gabriel Bortoleto’s Audi and the Alpines of Franco Colapinto and rookie Paul Aron.

Aron was the quickest of four rookie drivers appearing in this session, despite a few close calls with other cars - including Racing Bulls sub Yuki Tsunoda, who got blocked by the Alpine approaching Parabolica.
Oscar Piastri was only 11th in the other McLaren, despite using the soft tyre. McLaren also trialled its new upside down H-wing during this session.
Tsunoda was 11th quickest, ahead of Nico Hulkenberg’s Audi and Ollie Bearman, whose Haas is the only customer using the new Ferrari engine this weekend.

Rookie FP1 driver Luke Browning was just under a tenth quicker than regular Williams driver Carlos Sainz, despite a couple of moments through the first chicane, though unlike Browning Sainz didn’t run the soft tyre in FP1.
Ayumu Iwasa was only 17th in Max Verstappen’s Red Bull, half a second clear of Fernando Alonso in the underpowered Aston Martin (another to eschew the soft tyre).
Colton Herta was the other FP1 substitute, but the Cadillac usually driven by Sergio Perez broke down with a suspected hydraulics problem before Herta could set a proper lap time.

detailZh: F1意大利大奖赛：夏尔·勒克莱尔领跑，法拉利在第一次自由练习中包揽前二
法拉利在蒙扎的主场F1比赛开局强势，夏尔·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿占据第一次自由练习的前两名
夏尔·勒克莱尔领跑法拉利包揽前二，在F1意大利大奖赛的第一次自由练习中做出最快圈速
勒克莱尔用中性胎做出的1分23.008秒圈速，在历史悠久的蒙扎赛道一个炎热夏日午后，足以险胜队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿
勒克莱尔在三节练习赛中的第一节进行到一半时做出了他的最快圈速，提升了意大利主场车迷的期待。
法拉利身披致敬迈克尔·舒马赫1996年——即30年前——加盟法拉利首个赛季的复古涂装，带着最新的一整套升级件来到主场赛道。这些升级包括一个经过改进的低阻力尾翼，以及车队被允许进行的第二次引擎升级，旨在帮助缩小其动力单元与梅赛德斯之间的差距。
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯在练习赛前期一直领先，直到科尔顿·赫塔受损的凯迪拉克赛车上场使练习中断。这位美国车手被他的车队要求因液压故障将车停下，红旗因此出示。
测试车手赫塔原本希望通过这次练习赛再获取一个超级驾照积分，但由于行驶里程不足，这位前印地赛车好手将无法凭借他在蒙扎的这次出场获得积分。
计时还剩34分钟时练习恢复进行，梅赛德斯的拉塞尔先跑进了诺里斯的成绩，随后勒克莱尔用中性胎以1分23.008秒占据榜首。
汉密尔顿跟随勒克莱尔位列第二，使用相同的中性胎比队友慢了0.173秒；拉塞尔则用软胎做出1分23.312秒的单圈，重新回到第三，比领先的法拉利慢了约十分之三秒。
劳森获得第四名，他重新回到红牛车队，因为正赛车手哈贾尔仍在从手腕伤势中恢复，他排在了积分榜领先者安东内利之前。
安东内利因整套动力单元更换将面临从发车区末尾发车的处罚，因此他完全专注于优化自己的比赛调校。
这位意大利车手将诺里斯挤到第六位，排在他前面的是小红牛（小红牛）车手阿尔维德·林德布拉德和奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托。阿尔派车队的两位车手佛朗哥·科拉平托和保罗·阿隆排在第九和第十位，其中这位爱沙尼亚车手在皮埃尔·加斯利的赛车上完成了新秀自由练习一的任务。
在迈凯伦的另一辆赛车上，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里位列第11，排在他前面的是角田裕毅，后者获得了第二次机会，填补劳森暂时空出的小红牛（小红牛）席位。
赫塔和阿隆只是自由练习一中出现的四名新秀车手中的两位。岩左步梦在红牛车队顶替了马克斯·维斯塔潘的位置，而威廉姆斯车队的年轻车手卢克·布朗宁则在亚历克斯·阿尔本的车上进行了练习。各车队借此机会完成了本赛季四场强制新秀自由练习之一，本站是不设冲刺赛的周末。
由于气温升过了约定的31摄氏度阈值，并且预计每个上场环节都会如此，国际汽联宣布本周末的比赛为高温危险天气，迫使车手们要么穿着冷却背心，要么携带额外的配重。
detailEn: F1 Italian GP: Charles Leclerc leads Ferrari 1-2 in FP1
Ferrari started its Formula 1 home race in Monza on the front foot with Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton topping first free practice
Charles Leclerc led a Ferrari 1-2 to set the fastest time in first free practice at Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix.
Leclerc's time of 1m23.008s, set on medium tyres, was quick enough to pip team-mate Lewis Hamilton on a hot summer afternoon at the historic Monza circuit.
Leclerc set his time halfway through the first of three practice sessions, boosting expectations from the partisan home crowd in Italy.

Sporting a throwback livery paying tribute to Michael Schumacher's first season with Ferrari in 1996, 30 years ago, Ferrari came to its home track with its latest suite of upgrades. Those updates include a refined low-drag rear wing and the Scuderia's second permitted engine upgrade that aims to help slash its power unit deficit to Mercedes.

Reigning world champion Lando Norris had been leading the early running before the session was interrupted by Colton Herta's stricken Cadillac. The American was asked by his team to park the car with hydraulic issues, bringing out the red flag.
Test driver Herta had been hunting another superlicence point with his practice outing, but due to his lack of mileage the former IndyCar ace will not get one for his Monza run.
The session resumed with 34 minutes on the clock, with Mercedes' George Russell dipping below Norris' time before Leclerc took charge with a 1m23.008s on medium rubber.

Hamilton followed Leclerc through in second, shipping 0.173s to his team-mate on the same medium compound, as Russell reclaimed third with a 1m23.312s lap on soft tyres, three tenths down on the leading Ferrari.
Liam Lawson, who returned to Red Bull as regular driver Isack Hadjar continues to recover from his wrist injury, took fourth ahead of championship leader Antonelli.
Antonelli faces a back-of-the-grid penalty for a full power unit change and therefore is fully focused on optimising his race set-up.

The Italian demoted Norris to sixth ahead of Racing Bulls man Arvid Lindblad and Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto. Alpine duo Franco Colapinto and Paul Aron, with the Estonian performing rookie FP1 duties in Pierre Gasly's car, rounded out the top 10.
In the second McLaren, Oscar Piastri was 11th ahead of Yuki Tsunoda, who received a second opportunity to fill Lawson's temporarily vacated Racing Bulls seat.

Herta and Aron were just two of four rookie drivers out on track in FP1. Ayumu Iwasa took Max Verstappen's place at Red Bull and Williams young driver Luke Browning got a run in Alex Albon's car as teams took the opportunity to satisfy one of the four mandated rookie FP1 runs for the season on a non-sprint weekend.

With temperatures soaring above the agreed threshold of 31 degrees and expected to do so for every on-track session, the FIA declared a heat hazard for this weekend's running, forcing drivers to either wear cooling vests or carry additional ballast.

detailZh: Netflix发布新版迈克尔·舒马赫1994年F1纪录片预告片
Netflix发布了纪录片《Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend》（舒马赫94：传奇的诞生）的预告片，这部新纪录片讲述了迈克尔·舒马赫的首个F1总冠军头衔
迈克尔·舒马赫与他的车队一起庆祝夺冠
Netflix已发布其即将推出的F1纪录片《Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend》（舒马赫94：传奇的诞生）的预告片，该片将于10月2日全球首播。
这部德语纪录片长片由 LEONINE Documentaries 制作，Christin Freitag 执导，聚焦于迈克尔·舒马赫的首个冠军头衔。
新发布的预告片预览了1994赛季的幕后细节，这位德国车手在那个赛季赢得了他的第一个F1冠军，其中包括一些与这位七届冠军最亲近的人的见解。
他的妻子科琳娜·舒马赫在纪录片中占有重要篇幅。片中还包括对前贝纳通车队领队弗拉维奥·布里亚托利、前F1首席执行官伯尼·埃克莱斯顿、舒马赫的前经纪人威利·韦伯、前F1车手大卫·库特哈德以及德国资深播音员 Kai Ebel 和 Heiko Waßer 的采访。
这部Netflix纪录片的简介写道：“1994年是F1历史上的一个转折点：25岁的迈克尔·舒马赫在巴西赢得赛季首场大奖赛，开启了一段前所未有的职业生涯。”
“1994年是F1历史上最戏剧化、最激动人心的赛季之一，这一年间发生了许多影响深远的事件，例如埃尔顿·塞纳（Ayrton Senna）的致命事故，以及关于操纵比赛和不公平驾驶行为的指控。与此同时，一股真正的‘舒米狂热’（Schumi Mania）也席卷而来。”
剧情简介继续写道：“迈克尔·舒马赫（Michael Schumacher）的妻子科琳娜·舒马赫（Corinna Schumacher）以及他身边的其他人回忆起了那时的他。他们记得他在赛道上是一个毫不妥协的斗士，而在赛场之外则是一个敏感、富有同理心的人。
“一直是他情感支柱的科琳娜·舒马赫，还讲述了一段非凡爱情故事的开端——这段爱情至今依然牢不可破。”
粉丝们对这部纪录片的期待已经开始升温。“F1史上的最伟大车手，”一位粉丝在YouTube上简单地评论道，而另一位粉丝则开始了上映倒计时，写道：“还剩4周！”
detailEn: Netflix releases trailer for new Michael Schumacher 1994 F1 documentary
Netflix has released the trailer for "Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend", a new documentary exploring Michael Schumacher's first F1 championship title
Michael Schumacher celebrates championship victory with his team
Netflix has released the trailer for its upcoming Formula 1 documentary, Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend, ahead of its global premiere on 2 October.
Produced by LEONINE Documentaries and directed by Christin Freitag, the German-language feature focuses on Michael Schumacher's maiden championship title.

The newly released trailer previews behind-the-scenes details from the 1994 season, in which the German driver claimed his first F1 title, and includes insights from some of those closest to the seven-time champion.

His wife, Corinna Schumacher, features heavily in the documentary. It also includes interviews with former Benetton team principal Flavio Briatore, former F1 chief executive Bernie Ecclestone, Schumacher's former manager Willi Weber, former F1 driver David Coulthard and veteran German broadcasters Kai Ebel and Heiko Waßer.

"1994 marks a turning point in Formula 1 history: 25-year-old Michael Schumacher wins the first grand prix of the racing season in Brazil, setting the stage for an unprecedented career," the synopsis of the feature film from Netflix reads.

"The year 1994, which is among the most dramatic and exciting racing seasons in Formula 1 history, featured impactful events such as Ayrton Senna's lethal accident, as well as accusations of manipulation and unfair driving manoeuvres. At the same time, a true 'Schumi Mania' emerged."

The synopsis continued: "Michael Schumacher's wife, Corinna Schumacher, and other people close to him reminisce about him at that time. They remember an uncompromising fighter on the race track and a sensitive, empathic man off the course.
"Corinna Schumacher, who has always been his emotional support, also offers insight into the beginnings of an extraordinary love story - one that is still going strong today."
Excitement for the documentary is already building among fans. "The GOAT of F1," one fan commented simply on YouTube, while another began the countdown to the release, writing: "4 weeks left!"

detailZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利失去摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台席位，国际汽联上诉法院裁定
国际上诉法院裁定，皮埃尔·加斯利在摩纳哥大奖赛收到的、此前曾被撤销的处罚依然有效
国际汽联国际上诉法院（ICA）裁定，阿尔派车队一级方程式车手皮埃尔·加斯利最终失去了他在摩纳哥大奖赛的领奖台完赛成绩，他因在维修通道超速而受到的处罚维持不变
加斯利是在该赛事中因维修通道超速被处罚的多名车手之一，但后来发现维修通道的测量数据不准确，前两个计时点之间存在77厘米的误差——这也是处罚数量异常之多的原因
当奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和乔治·拉塞尔等人因为在比赛中执行处罚而蒙受损失时——拉塞尔的处罚执行方式有误，这位梅赛德斯车手因此被处以穿过维修区的处罚——加斯利的两个五秒处罚则被加到了他的比赛成绩上，使他从第三名跌至第七名。这一时机意味着阿尔派车队得以申请复审。
FIA赛事干事随后于6月12日推翻了这些处罚，加斯利因此恢复了第三名的位置。但对于那些在比赛期间执行处罚的车手来说，这并非可行的选择。
红牛车队的伊萨克·哈贾尔和迈凯伦车队的皮亚斯特里蒙受了损失，分别从第三和第四名跌至第四和第五名。因此两支车队都向国际上诉法院（ICA）提起了上诉；这一举措得到了小红牛车队（其两名车手均在成绩榜上各失去一个位置）和英国赛车运动协会（Motorsport UK）的支持。
法院于周五裁定处罚有效，因此加斯利重新跌回第七名，而他的同胞哈贾尔则继承了第三名——这位红牛车手在赛后已经庆祝过这个位置。
加斯利（阿尔派车队）、哈贾尔（红牛 比赛车队）
ICA的部分推理依据是，阿尔派无法完全确定地证明Gasly在维修区内实际行驶的距离比（不准确地）测量出的距离更远，因此其在两个计时点之间较短的时间可能反映出“更短的路线、更高的速度，或两者的结合”。
然而，ICA确认，其他车手已经服完处罚“不能成为取消一项不合法处罚的障碍，因为那些处罚是由车队自行斟酌和选择而执行的。若以会造成体育不公平为由持相反观点，反而会与体育公平相悖。”
阿尔派对这一决定表示“失望和沮丧”，仍然坚称Gasly没有任何过错，不应受到任何处罚。
车队在声明中表示：“车队对国际汽联国际上诉法庭就2026年摩纳哥大奖赛结果所作出的裁决表示失望和沮丧。”
“尽管我们不同意这一决定，并且仍然完全坚持10号车在比赛期间任何时候都没有超过维修区限速，但车队接受近期在巴黎举行的听证会上裁判小组作出的决定。”
“虽然这一结果并非我们所期望的，因为我们认为自己受到了不公正的处罚，但车队将坚定地专注于继续提升赛道上的表现，并仍处于一场激烈而胶着的冠军争夺战中。”
“这一结果不会削弱车队在赛季结束前实现其目标的努力和动力。”
与此同时，国际汽联（FIA）在一份声明中坚称，其赛事干事做出错误决定并不一定负有责任，但该联合会承诺将审查其相关流程。
声明中写道：“国际汽联注意到国际上诉法院（ICA）今天就8月25日星期二听证会（案件编号 ICA-2026-06-07-08-09）做出的决定。”
“国际上诉法院的裁定支持了迈凯伦F1车队（迈凯伦 F1 Team）和红牛车队（红牛 比赛）针对摩纳哥大奖赛第99号文件中赛事干事决定所提出的上诉，实际上推翻了这些决定。”
“国际汽联正在审查当前一级方程式计时系统的方法和运作以及相关的规则事务。还将审查其他司法程序和运作，包括复审权以及上诉流程。”
“国际汽联（FIA）完全支持干事（Stewarding）工作流程，以及由多元化干事小组所具备的独立性和客观性，他们是全球赛车运动不可或缺的一部分。
“干事的裁决是在与法庭不同的环境下作出的，而法庭可以获得大量额外的法律顾问意见、辩论和证据。
“国际汽联干事不断审视其工作流程，并参与大量的专业发展培训。国际汽联干事会仔细研究国际上诉法院（ICA）的每一项裁决，以确保流程的持续改进。”
detailEn: Pierre Gasly loses Monaco GP podium, FIA’s Court of Appeal rules
The International Court of Appeal has ruled that Pierre Gasly’s Monaco GP penalties, which had been rescinded, do stand
Alpine Formula 1 driver Pierre Gasly has lost his Monaco Grand Prix podium finish after all, as his penalties for pitlane speeding stand, the FIA’s International Court of Appeal (ICA) has ruled.

Gasly was one of several drivers who were pinged for pitlane speeding during the race in the principality, but it emerged the pitlane measurements were inaccurate, with a discrepancy of 77cm between the first two timing loops – hence the unusual number of penalties.

While the likes of Oscar Piastri and George Russell lost out by serving their penalties during the race – incorrectly served in Russell’s case, with the Mercedes driver consequently incurring a drive-through sanction – Gasly’s couple of five-second penalties were added to his race time, dropping him from third to seventh. The timing meant Alpine was able to request a right of review.
FIA stewards subsequently overturned the penalties on 12 June, meaning Gasly was reinstated in third position. But this wasn’t an option for the drivers who served their penalties during the race.

Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar and McLaren’s Piastri lost out, dropping from third and fourth to fourth and fifth. Both teams therefore appealed the decision before the ICA; the move was supported by Racing Bulls, whose drivers both lost a spot in the classification, and Motorsport UK.
The Court ruled on Friday that the penalties do stand, so Gasly is back down to seventh, with fellow countryman Hadjar inheriting the third place the Red Bull racer celebrated post-race.
Pierre Gasly, Alpine, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

Part of the ICA’s reasoning was that Alpine couldn’t prove with full certainty that Gasly had travelled a longer distance in the pitlane than (inaccurately) measured, so its shorter time between the timing loops could reflect “a shorter path, greater speed, or a combination of both”.

However, the ICA confirmed that other drivers having served their penalties “cannot be an obstacle to the cancellation of an illegitimate sanction, because those penalties were served at the discretion and choice of the team. Admitting the contrary on the grounds that it would create sporting unfairness would in return be inconsistent with sporting fairness.”
Alpine has expressed “disappointment and frustration” with the decision, still adamant that Gasly did nothing wrong and was undeserving of any penalties.
“The team expresses its disappointment and frustration with the outcome reached by the FIA International Court of Appeal relating to the result of the 2026 Monaco Grand Prix,” a team statement read.

“While we disagree with the decision, and still fully maintain that Car #10 did not exceed the Pit Lane speed limit at any point during the race, the team acknowledges the decision of the judging panel from the recent hearing in Paris.

“While the result is not what we had hoped for, as we feel that we have been unjustly punished, the team is firmly focused on continuing to improve its performance on track and remains in a close and very competitive Championship fight.
“This outcome will not deter the team’s efforts and motivation in achieving its objectives by the end of the season.”
Meanwhile, an FIA statement insisted that its stewards weren’t necessarily to blame for making a wrong decision, though the federation pledged to review its processes.
“The FIA notes the decision today from the International Court of Appeal (ICA) in relation to the hearing of Tuesday, August 25 (case ICA-2026-06-07-08-09),” the statement read.

“The ICA decision upholds the appeals of McLaren F1 Team and Red Bull Racing against the decisions of the stewards contained in document 99 of the Monaco Grand Prix, effectively overturning those decisions.

“The FIA is reviewing the methodology and operation of the current Formula 1 timing system and the related regulatory matters. It will also be reviewing other judicial procedures and operations including the right of review and the appeal processes.
“The FIA is fully supportive of the Stewarding process and the independence and objectivity of the diverse panels of Stewards who are an integral part of global motorsport.
“Stewards’ decisions are taken in a different environment to that of the Court, whereas the Court has access to extensive and additional legal counsel input, arguments and evidence.

“The FIA Stewards constantly review their processes and take part in extensive professional development. Every decision of the ICA is carefully examined by FIA Stewards ensuring a process of continuous improvement.”
